answer: Require every identity to lock a small refundable bond before it can earn, and release rewards only after a public challenge window in which any peer can contest the work. A crystal-clear ledger shows each bond, so a sybil farm must fund a separate bond for every fake and loses it on any failed challenge - the bridge between cheap copies and real cost. Like a harbor that only admits ships that paid the docking fee, the network admits only identities with something at stake, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds.
